purpose: User-authorized experimental forecast attachment; no frozen research promotion

references.title: Amazon Chronos-2 official model card
references.verification_scope: Official model-card metadata reviewed; pinned runtime checks the expected weight digest before loading.
references.supports: 120M-parameter pretrained model, joint quantile forecasting, CPU support and Apache-2.0 model license.
references.does_not_establish: ETF return accuracy, interval calibration, clean training/test separation or a third-party market-data redistribution license.

references.title: Chronos-2: From Univariate to Universal Forecasting
references.verification_scope: Primary paper title, authorship and abstract reviewed; no independent benchmark reproduction.
references.supports: Architecture motivation for zero-shot multivariate and covariate-informed inference using related series.
references.does_not_establish: Sentinel's 253-close window, five-session target, Gaussian baseline or predictive usefulness on these ETFs.

references.title: Pretrained Time-Series Foundation Models for Financial Return Forecasting
references.verification_scope: Primary paper abstract reviewed; five individual US equities, rolling-origin comparison, no reproduction.
references.supports: Reason to include random-walk comparisons and distinguish model ranking from a reliable financial advantage.
references.does_not_establish: Universal alpha, Chronos-2 superiority or validation of Sentinel's ETF/relative targets.

references.title: Multivariate Financial Forecasting using the Chronos Time Series Foundation Models
references.verification_scope: Primary paper abstract reviewed; equity, rate and combined panels with rolling monthly evaluations; no reproduction.
references.supports: Motivation to group related equity series; reported loss of accuracy when combining equities and rates.
references.does_not_establish: Causal five-session ETF return accuracy, calibrated relative-return intervals or an approved macro feature set.

references.title: TimesFM-3: A zero-shot foundation model for multivariate forecasting
references.verification_scope: Official Google Research release reviewed; published August 31, 2026.
references.supports: Awareness of a newer, 330M-parameter multivariate alternative.
references.does_not_establish: A tested model comparison or financial performance advantage for this integration.

references.title: Official Google TimesFM 3.0 PyTorch model card
references.verification_scope: Official model-card license label and license section reviewed.
